about.en: COINon is the Ondo tokenized stock for Coinbase Global, Inc. (COIN), issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited on the Ondo Global Markets platform and offered to eligible non-US investors. It is fully backed by COIN shares and is a total-return tracker: dividends are reinvested net of withholding tax, so one token can come to represent more than one share and its price can drift above the underlying's. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership or shareholder rights. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0xF042cfa86cf1D598a75Bdb55c3507a1F39f9493b, with deployments on BNB Chain, Solana and HyperEVM.
